title: Jezero v1 Signed Data Pack Ready (708 Perseverance Stops + Multi-Scale Hazard Grid)
body: All static files are live in public_packs/jezero/v1/ (1.6 MB total): manifest.json, waypoints.geojson (708 stops with rover_tilt_deg & panorama_url), route.geojson (MEASURED traverse + SIMULATED <2km EVA corridor + 3 stops), hazard_grid.json (1m/4m/16m/64m slopes + confidence {t,i,f} + GO/CAUTION/NO_GO), hazard_overlay.png (transparent RGBA heatmap), and eva_constraints.json. Note: Mars Trek 25cm HiRISE tiles use a 2:1 geographic grid (EPSG:4326 style) which renders natively in Leaflet (L.CRS.EPSG4326), OpenLayers, or Cesium.
